items.title: The sheaf of differentials of a morphism of algebraic spaces restricts to the relative differentials along an etale commutative square
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces), section on the sheaf of differentials of a morphism of algebraic spaces
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma takes a morphism of algebraic spaces f : X -> Y over a scheme S and a commutative square with etale vertical maps a : U -> X and b : V -> Y, and asserts the restriction formula Omega_{X/Y}|_{U_etale} = Omega_{U/V}, with the scheme case of the usual sheaf of differentials as a corollary (statement lines 980-996). The proof does not run through presentations of algebraic spaces at all: it identifies restriction to U_etale with pullback along a_{small} by the etale-topos equivalence, applies the localisation lemma for differentials on ringed sites, and then rewrites the coefficient sheaf of rings through the commutativity of the square (proof lines 999-1013). The step that carries the content is that last rewriting, because it is the only place where the hypothesis that the square commutes is used. The proof is short but has no gap and no omitted argument, so H2.
